title: Elegant Creamy Middle-Eastern Lamb Tagine
description: Buttery, creamy tagine made with tender lamb, sweet pomegranate, and fragrant spices, all in a rich tandoor-style sauce.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee in a large wok over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of ghee to the wok and cook the chopped onion until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper to the wok and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pomegranate molasses, salt, and browned lamb to the wok and stir to combine.
Return the heat to medium-low and simmer the tagine, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and a dollop of yogurt (optional).
Reheat the tagine over low heat for 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, if not serving immediately.
